key_insight: AdamW’s fixed points match stationary points of an implicit constrained, regularized objective, but its dynamics can destabilize them and produce persistent oscillations.
engineering_relevance: The analysis shows why reaching an AdamW equilibrium is not guaranteed and how curvature, weight decay, and momentum affect stability.
method: Analyze equilibrium stability and oscillations, including in one dimension.
Derive sufficient higher-dimensional continuous-time stability conditions and propose a convergent modification preserving fixed points.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical stability results and one-dimensional non-convergence behavior, but no empirical datasets or benchmark evaluations.
watch_item: Continuous-time stability conditions alone do not establish convergence for practical discrete-time AdamW implementations.
paper_title: A Stability Analysis of AdamW: Unstable Equilibria and Non-Convergence
